approaches.name: geo-referenced climate risk and housing information mapping
approaches.description: Finances geo-referenced climate risk maps and a Housing Information System to guide territorial planning and investment design. Practices: Geo-referenced climate risk mapping for territorial planning; Housing Information System with geo-referenced housing data; geo-referenced climate risk mapping for municipal planning.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: geo-referenced climate risk maps for planning - cue: 'geo-referenced' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: The technical assistance for urban planning, under activity (i) above, shall include, inter alia: (i) providing support for the development of geo-referenced climate risks mapping to support informed territorial planning, and specific investments design to support streamlining the climate resilience requirements in all future government plans and investments;

extra_evidence.text: (ii) providing support for the development and implementation of a Housing Information System, launched under the SOE related Fiscal Management Project (P160796).

This system is expected to provide geo- referenced information on the social, economic, legal and urban dimensions, with the objective of reducing the gap between demand and supply of housing in Cabo Verde.

Similarly, this component will finance US$1.65 million towards Technical Assistance for municipal planning to support for the development of geo-referenced climate risks mapping to support informed territorial planning, and specific investments design to support streamlining the climate resilience requirements in all future government plans and investments.

category.rationale: Technological: GIS mapping is the core mechanism, not a delivery reform

sector.rationale: Climate risk mapping guides territorial planning and investment design, most directly serving urban transport planning.
